privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How SDK Enterprises handles personal data, in accordance with the GDPR (RGPD).
privacy.controller: The data controller is {company}, trading as {name}, registered office at {address}. For any question about your personal data, contact us at {email}.
privacy.collectedData: The only data-collection form on this site is the public "Start a project" form. The data requested is strictly limited to:
purposeItems: respond to your project enquiry — pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f));
operate, secure and improve the site — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f));
comply with any applicable legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)).
privacy.recipientsNote: Your data is accessible only to authorised people within SDK Enterprises. It may be processed by the following processors, strictly for the needs of their services:
privacy.transfers: Some processors may process data outside the European Economic Area (notably in the United States). Where this occurs, appropriate safeguards are used, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
privacy.retention: Data collected through the form is kept for 12 months from the last contact, unless a longer retention is required by law. After this period, it is deleted or anonymised.
privacy.rightsNote: In accordance with Articles 15 to 22 GDPR, you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. You may also withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, write to us at {email}. We respond within one month. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
privacy.children: The site is aimed at professionals and is not intended for minors. The enquiry form is not intended for individuals under 16.
privacy.automated: No automated decision-making or profiling is carried out on your data.
privacy.security: Reasonable technical and organisational measures are in place to protect your data (encrypted connections, access controls). No absolute guarantee can be offered.
privacy.register: SDK Enterprises maintains an internal register of processing activities (Art. 30 GDPR). No CNIL declaration number is claimed or invented.
